name: Stoley's Debt
summary: At Steamwheedle Port, “Sea Wolf” MacKinley wants the rum Stoley wagered with him. He asks you to speak with the barkeep about it.

sections.title: A Matter of Rum and Coin
sections.body:
“Sea Wolf” MacKinley says Stoley owes him a special bottle of rum. Stoley boasted that Steamwheedle Port’s rum was stronger than anything in Booty Bay. He promised to double the money he owes MacKinley if MacKinley tried it and disagreed.

Now MacKinley thinks Stoley has lost his nerve about handing over the bottle. But MacKinley never backs away from a wager, so he asks you to speak with Stoley at the Steamwheedle Port bar.

sections.title: Stoley's Answer
sections.body: Stoley says he is not afraid to hand over Steamwheedle Bilge Rum. But there is no rum left to give.

faq.answer: “Sea Wolf” MacKinley is Stoley’s old friend. They have a wager over whose rum is stronger.
Stoley tends the bar at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

faq.q: What bet did Stoley make with MacKinley?
faq.answer: That Steamwheedle Port’s rum beats anything in Booty Bay. Stoley swore it was stronger, and promised MacKinley double the money owed if MacKinley tried it and disagreed.
